title: Inventory: collect repos, scripts, data, infra notes
body: Collect repo list, branches, scripts, readme/run notes, sample data, external deps. Acceptance: single inventory doc with links and short notes.

title: Define MVP scope & success metrics
body: Document core features, SLA targets, KPIs (latency, throughput, error rate), and acceptance criteria for MVP.

title: Create repo + enable Issues & Projects + labels
body: Create private repo data-pipeline-saas, enable Issues & Projects, add labels and milestones per plan.

title: Add Dockerfile(s) and docker-compose
body: Add Dockerfile(s) for PoC services and docker-compose or devcontainer with run instructions. Acceptance: docker build & run succeed.

title: Minimal IaC for staging (Terraform)
body: Create Terraform to provision object store, small VM or managed compute, and secrets; provide default variables for dev. Acceptance: apply creates resources.

title: CI pipeline: build & smoke test
body: Create GitHub Actions pipeline: build images, run unit tests, deploy to ephemeral staging, run end-to-end smoke test, save artifacts.

title: Add sample dataset & baseline tests
body: Add small representative dataset and a baseline set of unit/integration tests to run in CI.

title: Epic: Modularize PoC into components
body: Create epic that outlines components to extract, boundaries, and integration points. Link child tasks for refactor work.

title: Refactor scripts into modular components
body: Extract core logic into packages/modules with clear interfaces and tests. Acceptance: modules importable and tested.

title: Containerize components & publish images
body: Create Docker images for each component and push to registry; add semantic version tags.

title: Choose orchestration & prototype
body: Select Airflow or Dagster and implement prototype DAGs for 3 core workflows.

title: Implement retries, dependency handling & alerts
body: Add retries, DLQ pattern, and basic alerting for failed runs.

title: Add integration tests for DAGs
body: Add CI integration tests that run DAGs against sample data and validate outputs.

title: Expand unit/integration test coverage to 70% core
body: Increase test coverage for core modules; add contract/schema tests.

title: Implement data quality checks (Great Expectations)
body: Add basic data quality tests and CI gating for quality failures.

title: Integrate secrets manager
body: Integrate HashiCorp Vault or cloud secrets manager for credentials; update IaC.

title: Implement authentication prototype
body: Add basic JWT/OAuth flow for API/console and a simple user onboarding flow.

title: Security checklist & fixes
body: Run security checklist (deps audit, IAM least-privilege, secrets in code) and fix critical issues.

title: Add metrics, tracing, and centralized logging
body: Instrument services with OpenTelemetry, push metrics to Prometheus/Grafana, centralize logs.

title: Run load tests & tune autoscaling
body: Run k6/Locust tests, identify bottlenecks, and configure autoscaling policies.

title: Create onboarding docs & runbook
body: Write quickstart, API examples, and incident runbook for beta users.

title: Beta onboarding plan & invite list
body: Define beta criteria, invite list, success metrics for beta, and feedback loop.
